# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is **"R for Social Network Analysis"**, a practical guide
to analyzing, visualizing, and modeling networks in R. The book walks through
the standard descriptive toolkit, builds up `ggraph`-based visualizations, and
covers the main families of inferential models (ERGMs, stochastic actor-oriented
models, and relational event models), before closing with a tidyverse-style take
on network analysis via `tidygraph`.

The book is aimed at researchers, students, and practitioners who already know a
little R and want a guided tour of the network-analysis ecosystem without having
to stitch together a dozen package vignettes themselves.
